name: unprompted
title_zh: 翻你本地会话史，算出 AI 使用人格的 MBTI
tagline_zh: 不联网、不偷看别人，只分析你自己 Claude Code / Codex 的历史。两种对照模式、从不说的话。
tagline_en: Offline, private—reads only your own Claude Code/Codex logs. Two contrasting modes, things you never say.
desc_en: Analyze the user's own local Claude Code / Codex session history and show who they are on different projects — two contrasting modes, what they never say, the moments that contradict each other, and a playful MBTI-style AI-use persona with a bespoke card. Use when the user asks about their own AI-use patterns, prompting habits, "what do my sessions say about me", their AI-use personality or MBTI,
why_zh: 不是泛泛而谈的「效率报告」，而是从真实会话里挖出你从不说的话和自相矛盾的瞬间。
why_en: Not a generic productivity report—it digs real contradictions and unspoken patterns from your logs, then builds a persona with.
limit_zh: 只认本机 Claude Code / Codex 的会话记录，且需为 JSONL 格式；不读其他 AI 工具日志。
limit_en: Only reads local Claude Code/Codex JSONL session logs; no other AI tools. Output is a persona card + text analysis, not behavior coaching.
title_en: MBTI-style card from your own local AI session logs
